title: MFL Text
description: Black screens, primary colours, pixel typography and numbered football pages.
rationale: The nostalgic one. A proper football information service with keyboard page entry and Fastext-style navigation.

title: Touchline
description: Ivory paper, forest green, oversized serif headlines and a tactical pitch.
rationale: A calm, premium football journal. Strong hierarchy and generous space make long sessions feel lighter.

title: Floodlight
description: Aubergine, electric lilac, luminous stadium lights and a broadcast scoreboard.
rationale: A cinematic match-night experience with horizontal navigation and large, vivid performance graphics.

title: The Clubroom
description: Warm stone, oxblood, brass accents and traditional serif typography.
rationale: A club secretary’s desk reimagined: restrained, confident and rooted in football heritage.

title: Dugout
description: Cobalt, acid yellow, sharp black lettering and oversized athletic typography.
rationale: An energetic football brand built around player cards, squad building and decisive actions.

title: Control Room
description: Cool grey, signal orange, monospaced data and engineering grid lines.
rationale: A detailed working tool for the analytical manager, with compact tables and clearly exposed squad gaps.
